title: Banquet Guarantee Terms by Meetings & Events Package
content:
For each Meetings & Events package, banquet operations works to four guarantee figures: how many business days before the event the final guarantee is due, how far above the guarantee the kitchen prepares, whether attendance is billed on the greater of the guarantee and the actual count, and the most the guarantee may fall below the contracted attendance before billing is held at that floor.

| Package | Final guarantee due (business days before the event) | Kitchen overset above the guarantee | Billed on the greater of guarantee and actual count | Most the guarantee may fall below contracted attendance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | 3 | 3 percent | Yes | 10 percent |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | 3 | 3 percent | Yes | 10 percent |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | 3 | 3 percent | Yes | 10 percent |
| Social Reception Package | 5 | 5 percent | Yes | 15 percent |
| Wedding Celebration Package | 10 | 5 percent | Yes | 10 percent |
| Conference Plenary Package | 5 | 3 percent | Yes | 10 percent |

Business days here are Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays.

## Reading the table

- The overset is the share above the guarantee that the kitchen prepares for; it describes preparation, not billing.
- Every Meetings & Events package bills attendance on the greater of the guarantee and the actual count.
- The Social Reception Package allows the widest reduction, 15 percent; the other five allow 10 percent.
- The Wedding Celebration Package has the earliest due date, 10 business days before the event.

## Hypothetical illustration

For a Social Reception Package function with a guarantee of 200, the kitchen prepares for 5 percent above 200, that is for 210. For a Full-Day Meeting Package function with the same guarantee, it prepares for 3 percent above, that is for 206.
